architecture: external heated COPV jackets; independent external propellant-tank jackets and gas conditioners; sealed non-propellant coolant circuit; shielded engine bay

engine.basis: 1600 C catalog chamber-wall capability is an assumed radiation-source temperature, not a measured installation; 1000 W coupling and 600 s exponential cooldown are sensitivity requirements, not established bounds. Maintain onboard conditioning through one hour after capture, then require external service.

bottle.basis: Heater source 50 C, wall 40 C, bulk helium reference 20 C. Allocate 10 K to source/contact/wall and 20 K to inner-wall/gas; equal draw is nominal, +20% worst-bottle heat draw is an assumed sensitivity. Gas k and Nusselt examples are diagnostics, not PVG50 measured properties or correlations.

loop.basis: 30% propylene-glycol/water class. Dow 10 C values: cp3756, density1043.85, viscosity0.0045068 SI. cp>=3500, viscosity<=0.008 and fill density<=1.1kg/L at 6-8 C are design assumptions requiring confirmation. Four litres includes all nonpanel lines, jackets/HX and accumulator working charge; panel charge stays inside filled panel mass. The 40kPa nonpipe allocation must include the complete radiator panel, parallel jacket branches, gas conditioners, balancing/isolation/bypass valves, manifolds and carried pad exchanger if in the flight flow path; this is not measured loss.

components.name: four_engine_heat_shield_kits
components.basis: 4 x 2 kg installed allowance; ArianeGroup accessory class, actual kit mass and attenuation unavailable

components.name: engine_bay_thermal_intercepts_and_support_integration
components.basis: additional thermal isolation and penetration allowance; no credit from existing load-bearing frame

components.name: copv_heater_spreader_attachment
components.basis: custom segmented Minco space-heater class plus approved spreader/attachment; installed estimate, no vessel gas-side UA established

components.name: separate_external_liquid_jacket_and_trim_heater
components.basis: external thermal rails and heater estimate; no propellant recirculation or internal vessel modification

components.name: coolant_pump_package
components.basis: 150 W custom space MPFL pump package requirement, AMETEK PDT class; no selected catalogue pump performance/mass

components.name: coolant_accumulator
components.basis: dry accumulator and mounts estimate; working charge is in transport coolant row

components.name: coolant_bypass_isolation_and_balancing
components.basis: dry valves/manifold estimate; branch isolation and cold-radiator bypass required

components.name: nonpanel_thermal_transport_lines_and_fittings
components.basis: 10 m nominal 16 mm ID circuit and fittings estimate; material compatibility, wall thickness and installation need selection

components.name: nonpanel_retained_coolant
components.basis: kg/L fill upper design allocation; includes accumulator charge, excludes already-filled radiator panel

components.name: two_isolated_helium_conditioners
components.basis: two low-pressure flowing-gas conditioners, custom 1 kg each; no HP bottle heat credit

components.name: additional_thermal_sensors_and_control_harness
components.basis: additional temperature zones/control estimate; prior feed pressure sensors retained without subtraction

components.name: onboard_pad_exchanger_and_disconnects
components.basis: dry carried interface estimate; external pad plant excluded and unqualified

components.name: additional_thermal_blankets_and_attachment
components.basis: extra insulation estimate; prior tank/bus thermal allocations retained without credit
